releases.headline: Floating composer in maximized panels, Auto mode edits, and voice context
highlights: Added a floating composer pill at the bottom of maximized side panels with a live status bar showing agent progress, unread replies, and saved drafts; expand it to send follow-ups or start dictation without leaving the maximized view.
Expanded Auto mode to automatically approve safe file edits in other version-controlled repositories and non-replacing file additions outside your current project without prompting for confirmation.
Carried spoken context from live voice calls that end before handoff into the local conversation so the agent remembers what you discussed.
Added discovery for custom skills stored in `~/.agents/skills`, with skills in `~/.gemini` taking precedence if two skills share the same name.

Kept disabled plugin and Marketplace controls visible in Customizations as grayed-out options with an explanation tooltip when an organization administrator turns them off, while built-in plugins continue to work.

releases.headline: Switch models while a turn is running
Resume conversations after restart, auto-opening plugin panels, and compressed diagnostic uploads
highlights: Added automatic resumption on startup for active conversations interrupted by an app restart or update.
Updated plugin panel links in live agent replies to open their view automatically in the side panel.
